---
name: Feature request / task
about: Propose a feature, experiment, or roadmap task
title: "[Task] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Roadmap phase**
Which phase / Gate does this belong to? (one of Phase 0-8, Gate 0-3)

**Problem**
What gap does this close? Tie it to `blueprint.md` sections where possible.

**Proposed solution**
Design sketch, files/modules affected, interfaces (`types.py` changes?).

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches and why not.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Tests added/updated (`pytest -q` green)
- [ ] `roadmap.md` updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`
